dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: The 2D geometric profile exhibits a wide mid-body tapering gradually and symmetrically toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface with no dark-grey pigmentation observed.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; faint, sparse greyish longitudinal streaks are visible on the posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradient slopes between faint pigmented streaks and the depigmented white canvas are diffuse.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, linear white marks (rake marks) are distributed across the mid and posterior dorsal plane; a small dark focal spot is visible immediately posterior to the blowhole.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Significant longitudinal topological crease is visible along the central dorsal axis of the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple thin, linear white scars (consistent with rake marks) are present across the mid-dorsal and peduncle regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark, circular blowhole aperture is clearly visible on the anterior dorsal surface.
